column2: Concentration (passive)\nSharpens focus, so preparation is less easily broken\nby heavy damage.
Break Smash (active)\nA devastating blow to enemies in an area.\n★Warrior line only.
Toughness (passive)\nRaises [Armor] and [Body]. Lowers [Will], leaving you\nweaker to magic.
Burn Nap (active)\nSpins on the spot, striking every adjacent unit.\n★Warrior line only.
Life (passive)\nInvigorates body and mind, raising maximum [HP].

Aura Ray (active)
Unleashes a burst of energy at enemies in an area,
dealing slight damage.
★Warrior line only.

Angelic Arms (active)
With holy protection, raises physical [Power] and
[Hit].
★Warrior line only.

Shield Smith (passive)
Defensive know-how raises [Armor] and [Evade], but
lowers [Barrier].
★Swordsman line only.
Attack Sense (passive)\nDeeper attack know-how raises physical [Power].

Multi Attack (active)
Uses speed to strike several times at once. All
recovery time comes after the attack.
★Swordsman line only.

Air Slash (active)
Turns a sword's force into a shockwave with the
wind, striking distant enemies.
★Swordsman line only.

Eagle Claw (active)
Leaps high and lands a heavy blow. On a hit,
destroys the target's [GOOD conditions].
★Swordsman line only.
Skill Mastery (passive)\nSharpens focus to speed [MP regen], but slows [HP\nregen].
Hawk Eye (active)\nFor a short time, see even farther than a Hunter.\n★Swordsman line only.
Spiral Shot (active)\nShorter range, but stronger than a normal attack.\n★Hunter line only.

Multi Shoot (active)
Fires several arrows at once. All recovery time comes
after the attack.
★Hunter line only.
Regenerate (passive)\nSpeeds [HP regen].
Silver Arrowhead (passive)\nRaises physical [Power] and [Hit].\n★Hunter line only.
Arrow Rain (active)\nLoses many arrows skyward to rain down on a group.\n★Hunter line only.

Poison Arrow (active)
A poisoned arrow. On a hit, inflicts the BAD condition
[Poison], draining [HP] for a time.
★Hunter line only.

Snipe (active)
A carefully calculated shot at an enemy at the limit of
range.
★Hunter line only.

Mage Killer (active)
An enchanted arrow that damages [MP] and inflicts
the BAD condition [Mask], narrowing sight.
★Hunter line only.
Dissolution (active)\nLowers the target's magic defense.\n★Hunter line only.

Poison Trap (active)
Sets a trap that inflicts the BAD condition [Deadly
Poison] nearby, draining [HP] for a time. It catches
every unit but you.
★Hunter line only.
Crack Shot (active)\nLowers the target's armor.\n★Hunter line only.

Entangle Prison (active)
Sets a trap that inflicts the BAD condition [Slow]
nearby, slowing actions. It catches every unit but
you.
★Hunter line only.
Swift (passive)\nRaises [Evade] against physical attacks.
Critical Arrow (passive)\nMastering the bow's essence raises physical [Hit].\n★Hunter line only.
Recover (active)\nMay destroy [BAD conditions] on allies in an area,\nand restores a little [HP].
Bless (passive)\nSpeeds [MP regen].
Heal (active)\nRestores a little HP to allies around the chosen spot.
Holy Purge (active)\nSends holy light out from an ally, striking enemies\naround them.
Hermit Charm (passive)\nRaises [Barrier] and [Will] against magic.
Major Heal (active)\nRestores [HP] to allies around the target.\n★Priest line only.

Great Heal (active)
A long chant that restores a great deal of the target's
[HP].
★Priest line only.

Acid Chain (active)
Raises acid gas at the target's feet, a magic attack on
enemies in an area. Inflicts the BAD condition [Attack
Down].
★Priest line only.

Word of Curse (active)
Casts words of curse at enemies in an area, inflicting
the BAD condition [Restraint] and draining [MP] for a
time.
★Priest line only.
Truth (passive)\nRaises [Armor] and [Body].\n★Priest line only.
Power Blast (active)\nDeals a physical blow to a distant target.
Dark Chime (passive)\nSpeeds [HP regen] and [MP regen].\n★Priest line only.

Blood Ritual (active)
A long chant at the cost of your own [MP] that
restores [MP] to allies around you.
★Priest line only.

Dark Force (active)
A blow charged with darkness. Inflicts the BAD
condition [Restraint], damaging [MP] for a time.
★Priest line only.
Enchant Weapon (active)\nEnchants your weapon, granting the GOOD condition\n[Attack Up].
Mind Leak (active)\nWeakens the target's mind with the BAD condition\n[Magic Guard Down].
Clairvoyance (active)\nMagic grants the GOOD condition [True Sight],\nwidening the target's sight.

Noise (active)
Raises dust around the target to break focus. The
BAD condition [Magic Atk Down] lowers magic attack
for a time.

Dispel Magic (active)
Destroys [GOOD conditions] on the target and those
nearby, and restores a little [MP].
★Mage line only.
Life Force (active)\nAt a great cost in [MP], swiftly restores [HP] to allies\naround you.
Refuse Magic (active)\nDons armor that blocks magic, raising [Barrier] and\n[Will].
Phantom Image (active)\nLightens the body for swift action.

Magic Growth (active)
Grows magic plants at your feet, restoring [MP] to
allies around you.
★Mage line only.

Stone Fang (active)
Stone fangs thrust up from cracks in the earth.
Inflicts the BAD condition [Poison], draining [HP] for
a time.
Gaia (active)\nThe earth's protection grants a GOOD condition that\nraises [Armor] and [Body].

Earth Bind (active)
Gouges the ground and crushes foes between
boulders. Inflicts the BAD condition [Deadly Poison],
draining much [HP] for a time.
★Mage line only.
Magic Resist (active)\nThe earth's breath softens magic. A GOOD condition\nraises [Barrier] and [Will].
Wilderness (passive)\nThe earth's protection toughens body and mind,\nraising [Body] and [Will].
Sylph Field (active)\nA soft wind wraps the body, granting a physical\ndefense GOOD condition, mainly raising evasion.

Slow (active)
Holds back movement around the target with the
BAD condition [Slow]: slower movement, and longer
preparation and recovery on attacks and skills.
★Priest line only.
Thunderbolt (active)\nDrops lightning on enemies over a wide area. Not\nvery strong, but very quick to chant.
Tender Wind (active)\nA gentle wind restores a little [HP] to all around you,\nfriend or foe.
Feather Walk (passive)\nThe wind's protection raises [Move].
Quick Gate (passive)\nThe wind's protection shortens the time needed to\nwithdraw.

Tear Storm (active)
A small storm at one enemy damages [MP] and
inflicts the BAD condition [Magic Guard Down].
★Mage line only.
Web (active)\nA whip of freezing water. Inflicts the BAD condition\n[Frostbite], slowing actions.
Freeze Lance (active)\nCreates spears of ice that strike several targets.
Magic Reduce (active)\nAfter a long chant, restores a little lost [MP].\n★Mage line only.

Icicle Fall (active)
Freezes the area in a sudden chill and inflicts the
BAD condition [Attack Down].
★Mage line only.
Magician's Charm (passive)\nRaises maximum [MP].
Frost Harden (active)\nIce crystals strike every unit in range and inflict the\nBAD condition [Frostbite].

Tentacles Pile (active)
Tentacles of water seize nearby enemies. Inflicts the
BAD condition [Curse], heavily damaging [MP] for a
time.
Fire Arrow (active)\nHurls a mass of flame at the target.

Heat Accel (passive)
Raises magical strength and the [Power] of magic
attacks.
★Mage line only.
Explosion (active)\nA huge blast that catches friend and foe alike.

Master Force (passive)
Draws out hidden magic, raising magic [Power] to its
limit.
★Mage line only.
Strike Nova (active)\nShort range and a very long chant, but deals huge\ndamage.

Haste (active)
Quickens movement around the target with the
GOOD condition [Haste]: faster movement, and
shorter preparation and recovery on attacks and
skills.
★Priest line only.

Shooting Star (active)
Drops a mass of flame from high above, burning
enemies around it.
★Mage line only.
Striker (passive)\nRaises physical [Hit].

Iconoclast (active)
Summons a spirit called an Icon from the earth,
damaging the [MP] of everyone but you. Inflicts the
BAD condition [Curse], draining [MP] over time.
Power Word (active)\nGrants the GOOD condition [All Guard Up] and\nexplosive attack power for just a few seconds.
Holy Oath (passive)\nSlightly extends [Engage Time].
Soul Punisher (active)\nA magic strike on one target, with the longest chant\nand greatest power.
Resurrect Orb (passive)\nRaises [HP regen] to its limit, but greatly lowers [MP\nregen].
Sacrifice (passive)\nReduces the [Engage Time] lost when you withdraw\nat zero [HP].
